app.message: Service web is routed by Traefik but has no healthcheck; traffic starts as soon as the container starts
Traefik labels in labels are used on Kubernetes; on Swarm Traefik only reads deploy.labels
websecure is not reachable from outside when proxy.acme is false
app.hint: Set `proxy.acme: true` in config.yml to publish 443 and request certificates, or route this router through `web`.
